caseName: U. S. Term Limits, Inc. v. Thornton
caseNameFull: U. S. Term Limits, Inc. v. Thornton and Bryant, Attorney General of Arkansas v. Hill

opinions.text: Sup. Ct. Ark. Motions of Citizens for Term Limits et al. and Washington Legal Foundation et al. for leave to file briefs as amici curiae in No. 93-1828 granted. Certiorari granted, cases consolidated, and a total of one hour allotted for oral argument.
